items.title: Keep optional journey instrumentation from interrupting startup or play
items.stageRationale: Live local FORGE/FB beta hardening: reproduced failures disrupt real player loops; no lifecycle change.
items.premise: Resolve session storage inside a guard. Keep a bounded per-storage/tab memory fallback when reads or writes fail, with no network, absolute-time export or invented durability. Prove denied getter, quota, mid-session failure, deduplication and separate stores; prove actual game startup and checkpoint calls in the browser.
